newsitem.title: UK: Chubb sees growth in European D&O insurance.
newsitem.headline: Chubb sees growth in European D&O insurance.

text.p: U.S. Chubb Corp expects demand for Directors and Officers (D&O) liability insurance to grow in Europe as standards of corporate governance rise and U.S. litigation habits cross the Atlantic.

Chubb's D&O liability policies protect company directors and officers against losses resulting from lawsuits alleging misrepresentation, mismanagement, or material error or omission in the disclosure of financial information.

"We expect the European market for D&O to grow at 15-20 percent over the next five years," Tom Warden, Chubb executive protection manager for Europe, told Reuters after a company seminar on D&O insurance on Thursday.

Chubb, which this week said it was considering the sale of its life insurance operations, said earlier this year that D&O is one area which it has chosen to expand. It is the second largest D&O insurer in the U.S. after American International Group.
Industry experts estimate the global D&O market to be worth up to $3 billion in annual premiums, with the U.S. accounting for $1-2 billion.

Chubb executive protection specialist Cabot Wigger said the UK market was currently worth around 100 million stg and growing. Its D&O seminar attracted some 90 attendees, including existing clients, brokers and potential new clients.

Chubb already provides D&O cover to many leading European multi-nationals and is now targetting smaller companies whose exposure to D&O risks is rising as more of them access U.S. capital markets through instruments such as American Depositary Receipts.
"ADRs expose non-U.S. companies and their executives to the significant liability risks of the litigious U.S. market," Chubb said in a guide to D&O insurance.

Companies listing their securities in the U.S. subject themselves to U.S. securities law, which is among the most fertile areas for litigation, said Chubb, adding, "The fact that a company is headquartered or domiciled outside the U.S. does not shield it from litigation."
U.S. lawyer Michael Perliss said forces within Europe were also increasing the need for D&O cover, citing growing shareholder awareness, tougher regulation and more demanding rules on disclosure.
Perliss, a partner with Stroock & Stroock & Lavan, was one of the speakers at the seminar and has often worked with Chubb.
However, like most classes of insurance, D&O rates are coming under pressure from increased competition and new capacity coming into the market.

Warden said D&O overall remained a profitable line for the group, adding that Chubb concentrated on providing quality cover and would not chase rates down to uneconomic levels as some new players with little market experience were doing.
Other liability insurance growth markets identified by Chubb in Europe included errors and omissions (E&O) and pensions trustee liability, he added.
